name: Erasmus Mundus GrEnFIn (Greening Energy Market and Finance)
deadlineNote: 11:00 CET, via Univ. of Bologna Studenti Online
eligibility: Bachelor in economics/finance/business; IELTS; no work experience required
notes: Paris Dauphine track is 'Economics and Finance'. Confirm on the official consortium site.

name: Erasmus Mundus GLOCAL (Global Markets, Local Creativities)
notes: Global business and economic history. Check whether the track fits a finance profile.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary government)
funding: Full: tuition + monthly stipend + housing support + insurance
deadlineNote: Portal usually opens mid-November; no extensions
eligibility: Bangladesh is a partner country; also needs nomination by the Bangladesh Ministry of Education
notes: Strong backup with full funding. EU degree; you can move to Germany later for a job or PhD.

name: Erasmus Mundus EPOG (Economic Policies for the Global Bifurcation)
eligibility: Bachelor in economics or related; English B2/C1
notes: Includes finance and innovation tracks. Some tracks have a German partner university.

name: Erasmus Mundus catalogue: data, management, FinTech programmes
deadlineNote: Target date to finish the shortlist; most deadlines are Dec 2026 – Feb 2027
notes: Filter for business, economics, data. Pick 4–6. Up to 3 Erasmus Mundus applications per year are allowed.

name: Heinrich Böll Foundation (Master's)
eligibility: Needs German B2 / DSH 2, plus admission to a German university
notes: Realistic after you reach German B2. Keep for the 2028 round.

name: Goethe Univ. Frankfurt: MSc Money, Macro and Finance
deadlineNote: Window reported as about 1 Apr – 15 May 2027 (unconfirmed)
notes: Competitive and quant-heavy, in Germany's finance capital. Confirm the deadline on goethe-university-frankfurt.de.

name: Univ. of Magdeburg: International Management and Finance (MSc)
notes: Low living costs in eastern Germany. Good fit for a 3.25 CGPA.

name: Freie Universität Berlin: MSc Finance
notes: Berlin has many jobs but high rent. FU also runs the Deutschlandstipendium.

name: German public MSc in Business Analytics / Data (shortlist)
funding: No tuition outside Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg
deadlineNote: Target date to finish the shortlist; most deadlines are 31 May – 15 Jul 2027
notes: Use the DAAD International Programmes filter: Master, English, no tuition. Check Kiel, Duisburg-Essen, Magdeburg, Halle, Leipzig.

name: Friedrich Ebert Foundation (FES) Master's scholarship
deadlineNote: Sources disagree (30 Nov / 31 May / 31 Oct). Verify.
eligibility: Global South applicants; usually needs German skills and German university enrolment
notes: Apply in your first year in Germany.

name: Deutschlandstipendium
deadlineNote: After admission; each university has its own window (often Jul–Oct)
eligibility: Enrolled students at that university, any nationality
notes: Apply as soon as you're admitted.

name: German Embassy Dhaka: student visa waiting list
deadlineNote: Register the day you get an admission letter. Waits can be many months.
eligibility: Master's visas go through VFS. Holders of German-government or EU-funded scholarships count as 'qualified students'.
notes: Biggest delay risk for Winter 2027. An Erasmus Mundus scholarship helps here too.

name: Canada: funded thesis-based MSc (Finance / Analytics)
deadlineNote: Usually Dec – Feb for September entry
eligibility: Proof of funds CAD 23,448 + tuition (for applications from Sep 2026). Your budget covers this only with full funding.
notes: Only if fully funded. Thesis-based programmes are the ones that pay stipends. MBAs are too expensive.

name: DAAD EPOS (development-related postgraduate courses)
deadlineNote: Programme-specific, usually Aug – Oct, a year before the start
eligibility: Needs 2+ years of work experience. Not eligible yet.
notes: Target for 2029 if you work 2 years first, or for your spouse.
